items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I played here once with Jimmy Smith.

ctx.x: Did you have any experiences at the Howard Theatre performing?

Yeah, plenty. I played with a lot of different people at the Howard Theatre. I played here once with Olatunji and I played here once with Jimmy Smith. Outside of Art Blakey if that’s what you mean. On several different things, I came here with Dizzy’s band. I don’t know if we came here with Quincy but I know that we went to Baltimore at that club there, at the Regal Theatre there.
